# aura-components-mcp (v1.7.1 — 29 published tools; 35 in source with [Unreleased] award layer)

> Free-only MCP server (stdio, zero deps, no login) for the Aura (aura.build) public catalogue: 2,495 components, 192 skills, 30,688 assets, 725 design systems. Built by swastiksingh-dev (MIT). Catalogue content belongs to Aura (Meng To / DesignCode).

- Repo: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-components-mcp
- Setup: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP/blob/main/SETUP.md (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, OpenCode, Cline, Roo Code, DeepSeek Harness)
- Live demo videos: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP/tree/main/assets
- Official Aura MCP (account projects/publishing, OAuth): https://www.aura.build/mcp

## Start here

- Call `aura_status` first (reachability + live free counts).
- Then `aura_search_all` with the task words (all four surfaces, parallel, each with its own fallback pipeline — read `isFallback`/`no_match` per surface; mixed outcomes are normal).
- Then `aura_prompt` with the goal (draft + 6 questions: theme, sections, system, assets, macrostructure, vibe — ask user, then final with goal + answers). Pass 2 leads with `inspo.recommend` + `aura_inspo_recommend`.
- Then `aura_get_*` on 2-3 finalists, `aura_install_*` / `aura_use_design_system` on the winner.
- One-turn builds: `aura_bundle` (bulk details), `aura_scaffold_page` (tokens + system + markup ordered, refuses Pro ids, carries `docs_stamp`), `aura_related` (more-like-this).
- Fresh docs (pure helpers, agent calls Context7): `aura_docs_plan` (trusted: tailwind, gsap, lenis, iconify) + `aura_docs_check` (verdict + look-preserving fixes, excerpts under 20000 chars). Every install/scaffold carries `docs_stamp`. Conflict rule: fresh API wins, look stays identical.
- Free icons (live): `aura_icon {name}` returns ready-to-paste SVG from Font Awesome Free or the HackerNoon pixel library with auto-fallback, plus font/CSS alternative. CC BY 4.0 — credit line on every hit.
- Inspo bridge (pure mappers, no fetch — paste slim evidence): `aura_inspo_recommend` (strict macro gate: `need_macro:true` without a macrostructure), `aura_inspo_components`, `aura_inspo_reference`, `aura_inspo_system` (A/B/blend + `system_choice` question + contrast warning), `aura_inspo_compare` (2–4 slim sites → house style). Palette priority: brand hex > Inspo evidence > Aura tokens.
- Self-updating: `aura_version` compares running vs npm-published (hourly cache) and tells the agent to prefer latest; every `aura_status` already carries the verdict.
- Award intelligence ([Unreleased] in source, needs no browser for core use): `aura_award_search` (sites/categories/elements/motion, local index + one polite live refresh), `aura_award_inspect` (design DNA, elements, 2–3-site compare), `aura_design_blueprint` (goal + 2–5 refs → Markdown + v1 JSON mapped to real free Aura rows), `aura_visual_audit` (browser capture / band maps / ref-vs-build compare; Chrome optional), `aura_motion_study` (live scans, bounded frame records, stored-study search), `aura_award_index` (persistent corpus in `~/.aura-mcp/awards`, bounded crawl + winners + watches). Workflow: search → inspect → blueprint → audit → motion. See README + CHANGELOG.md.
- Lists are slim by default (excerpts + `code_info`/`content_info` + `full_fetch`); pass `slim:false` or call `aura_get_*` with `chunk` for full bodies. Truncated installs carry a `concat` plan + `css_scope_how`.
- Honest search: zero-overlap fallbacks return `total:0` + `no_match:true` + `refused_fallback` + `suggested_queries` (never masked popular rows). `exact_match:true` disables all fallbacks. `aura_trending` is removed — use per-surface `sort:'trending'` on the search tools instead.
- `aura_recommend` auto-retries once: empty components with `no_match:true` retry via `suggested_queries[0]` (same theme/negative_theme/min_views/slim filters, `retried_from` set), then fill from editorial picks (`editorial_fallback:true`) — `starter_kit.components` never dead-ends.

## Rules

- Free-only by default; Pro rows are refused with explanation, never leaked (`aura_install_component` errors; direct ID get/bundle refuse `-32602` fail-closed; `aura_scaffold_page` filters + reports `pro_filtered_out` / `dropped_refs`).
- `total` counts upstream matches for paging; local drops surface as `min_views_filtered_out` / `negative_theme_filtered_out` / `deduped` / `dropped_refs`.
- Asset license: all-rights-reserved per Aura Terms §4 (https://www.aura.build/terms) — preview ok, commercial reuse needs Aura permission.
- Icon license: every `aura_icon` hit is CC BY 4.0 (Font Awesome Free and HackerNoon pixel SVGs alike) — always keep its `credit` line; never strip it.
- Inspo evidence stays slim (slugs + palette + fonts + macro + mode + vibe, max 4 sites, no autopsy/screenshots); without a macrostructure, `aura_inspo_recommend` returns `need_macro:true` — run `inspo.recommend` first, never scaffold generic.
- Honest search: nonsense queries return honest empty (`total: 0`, `no_match: true`, `refused_fallback` name + `suggested_queries`) — never masked fallbacks. Pass `exact_match: true` to skip all fallbacks.
- `full: true` on `aura_get_component` / `aura_scaffold_page` returns full bodies (ignores `chunk`); lists stay slim by default.
- `aura_scaffold_page` components accepts `["732","1364"]` or `[{id:"732"}]` / `[{slug:"..."}]`.
- Categories overlap: per-category free counts sum past the free total (one component, many tags) — see `overlap_note`; they triage depth, not a partition.
- `status.freshness` is max `updated_at` per surface; counts mirror upstream live — flat counts + fresh timestamp means metadata moved, not new components.
